artifacts.summary: Confirms the dependency (task 257) landed and its return-meta-status-vocabulary.sh library is reusable; corrects the dispatch's own prerequisite claim by finding that system-defect-record.sh already has an agent-name-to-path resolver via --dispatched-agent, so only ~4 lines of local glue are needed rather than a new resolver; verifies the .reason vocabulary and current (drifted) line numbers in orchestrate-cycle-postflight.sh; confirms no enum collision with the completed sibling task 259; and lays out the discrimination, defect-class, and test-fixture options for the plan to decide.

memory_candidates.content: scripts/system-defect-record.sh already resolves a dispatched agent's source-store file path via --dispatched-agent NAME (nullglob over agent-system/extensions/*/agents/NAME.md), as an alternative to --attributed-path. Before concluding a task needs a new agent-name-to-file resolver, check this flag first -- it is undocumented outside the script's own header/comments (not mentioned in context/patterns/system-defect-discrimination.md's Signal B section).

agent-system/extensions/core/scripts/lib/return-meta-status-vocabulary.sh is the single sourced library for the 8-value .return-meta.json status enum (RETURN_META_STATUS_VALUES, RETURN_META_SUCCESS_STATUSES, is_return_meta_status, is_return_meta_success_status, RETURN_META_FORBIDDEN_STATUS/_MESSAGE for 'completed'). orchestrate-recover-outcome.sh and validate-return-meta.sh already source it; orchestrate-cycle-postflight.sh does not yet, as of task 258's research.
